newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks falter as currency woes continue.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks falter as currency woes continue.

text.p: Hong Kong shares in London were marked down across the board on Friday after a weak finish in Hong Kong prompted by regional currency woes, traders said.
"The market drifted easier all of the morning, but there were no real features," one London trader said.
The Hang Seng Reference Index fell 58.40 points or 0.37 percent to 15,599.72, after the Hang Seng itself fell 51.11 or 0.33 percent to 15,658.12 in active trading.
Earlier the Hong Kong index touched a low of 15,631.93.
Brokers said the market was likely to slip lower on regional currency concerns as institutional caution over the fallout from the Thai currency crisis checked momentum in the market.
